[[Koahm's Flatbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] dropped by [[Koahm the Weary]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[The Shattered Ravines]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:Lengthens [[Crippled]] duration on foes by 33% (Stacking)
:[[Energy]] +5
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Skull Flatbow]] [[dye]]d white.

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*[[Feathered Flatbow]] from crafter [[Ruricu]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Crippling]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*One of the following [[flatbow]]s:
**[[Feathered Flatbow]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Flatbow]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Flatbow]] from collector [[Zaishen Martial Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Flatbow]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Flatbow of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Flatbow]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Flatbow]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Flatbow]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Flatbow]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Flatbow]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Flatbow]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Crippling]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|I Have the Power]]" inscription

==Unique counterparts==
[[Deatheater Longbow]] and [[Bolten's Recurve Bow]] have stats identical to this item; however, they are different bow classes.
